AWE (subs.):
(1) भयम्;
(2) त्रासः;
(3) साध्वसम्;
(4) आदरः। N. B. There is no exact equiv.
of awe: 1, 2 and 3 mean fear, 4 means
respect. To stand in a. of: बिभेति (भी, c. 3)
(with abl.). Ph.: he is known to me and not
disagreeable, still
